answer_2.quote: GPT-4 achieves a precision of 0.39 ± 0.05 and recall of 0.64 ± 0.05 across all nine Issue-specific frames... Flan-T5-Large performs better than GPT-4 with a Macro F1 of 0.51 ± 0.05...

answer_4.quote: Through expert validation, we filter out 300 posts, resulting in 4.1K Expert+GPT-4 validated posts. Our expert validation involves discarding false positive labels by GPT-4; this results in a 12 point boost in precision... All annotators achieved an average inter-annotator agreement of 0.46 (Fleiss' κ)...
answer_4.guideline: OATH-Guidelines used for annotators during expert validation
